disease_state.ontology_name: carcinoma of liver and intrahepatic biliary tract

disease_state.evidence: This longitudinal proteomic analysis of the EVs circulating in the plasma of human patients undergoing PHx uncovers proteomic signatures associated with PHLF, which reflect dying hepatocytes and endothelial cells and were already present before PHx.

sample_source.evidence: Patient plasma was collected before PHx as well as 1 and 5 days after and the EV-protein repertoire was analysed by quantitative mass spectrometry using a super-SILAC mix prepared from primary and cancer cell lines.

tissue.evidence: Our study included nine patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) undergoing PHx.
